component.name: Get started/Figures/Use Plectrum in an app
Get started/Figures/Use Plectrum in an app

scripts.build:libs: ng build plectrum && ng build ui
scripts.test: ng test ui --watch=false && ng test ishare --watch=false && ng test plectrum --watch=false
scripts.test:coverage: ng test ui --watch=false --coverage && ng test ishare --watch=false --coverage && ng test plectrum --watch=false --coverage
scripts.storybook: npm run changelog:build && ng run ui:storybook
scripts.build-storybook: npm run changelog:build && ng run ui:build-storybook
scripts.test-storybook:ci: concurrently -k -s first -n SB,TEST "http-server dist/storybook/ui --port 6006 --silent" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:6006/iframe.html && test-storybook --config-dir libs/ui/.storybook --url http://127.0.0.1:6006 --coverage --coverageDirectory coverage/storybook"
